test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 29 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which party was recognized as a national political party by the Election Commission in 2016, whose official election symbol is Jora Ghas Phool (grass with two flowers)?
solution:
The correct answer is** 'All India Trinamool Congress (AITC)'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **All India Trinamool Congress (AITCC)**.

 
 
• Founded on: 1 January 1998 but on 2 September 2016 the Election Commission recognised AITC as a national political party.
 
• Election symbol: Jora Ghas Phool (grass with two flowers)
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Communist Party of India (CPI)**:

 
 
• The CPI was formed on 25 December 1925 at the party congress held in Kanpur.
 
• But the Communist Party of India (Marxist), which was formed after the party split in 1964.
 
• Election symbol: Bali-Sickle
 
 
 
• **Nationalist Congress Party (NCP):**
 
 
• It was founded on 25 May 1999 by Sharad Pawar, P A Sangma and Tariq Anwar after they were expelled from the Congress over the issue of Sonia Gandhi's nationality and leadership.
 
• Election symbol: Analogue alarm clock. The clock is drawn in blue and has two legs and an alarm button. It is situated on the tricolour Indian flag.
 
 
 
• **Bahujan Samaj Party (BSP)**:
 
 
• The ideology of the party is inspired by the humanistic philosophy of Bhimrao Ambedkar as well as Buddhist philosophy. The party was formed on 14 April 1984 by Kanshi Ram, who was once a charismatic leader of Dalits.
 
• Election symbol: Elephant
